messages:
tom_sales: Heads up — MedConnect (regional health ISV) asking for a one-time blended discount: 32% off year1 (Hosted API + Dedicated nodes) + waive onboarding SOW. They want Net75 due to grant funding schedule. Need deal desk + finance signoff.

jade_dealdesk: Oof Net75 is long. What
oes TCV look like and upside?

tom_sales: Proposed TCV = $290k (list ~$426k). Upside: platform embedded in partner apps; estimated $800k Y2. They're asking to be a named partner/reference.

sophie_revops: Quick calc:
```
List: $426,000
Proposed: $289,680
Discount: 32%
Est. margin: ~15%
```
Waiving SOW without trade risky.

arpit_finance: Finance can consider 32% + modified terms if (1) 20% non-refundable upfront, (2) PO with budget holder, (3) convert SOW fee to service credits, (4) Net60 max (not Net75). Also require expansion milestone and clawback at month 12. Provisional until legal drafts amendment.

tom_sales: Customer says grant cashflow forces Net75. They may accept 20% PO + proof of award and Net60 thereafter.

jade_dealdesk: Recommend: accept PO + 20% non-refundable, apply SOW as credits, and add 12-month expansion milestone tied to partial rebate. No stacking with other promos.

marta_legal: I can draft amendment and partner addendum with the clawback language and grant-proof clause. Need exact SOW items to convert to credits.

billing-bot: Created invoice template stub: /invoices/templates/medconnect_oneoff_waiver_v1.docx

arpit_finance: Marking provisional approval per conditions above. Final sign-off once PO + grant proof + signed amendment received. :white_check_mark:

tom_sales: I'll push procurement for PO and award letter. Will post here when landed. Thanks folks. :pray:
